entries.title: Jeremiah 31:1
segments: ¶"At the same time," says the LORD, "I will be the God of all the families of Israel, and they shall be My people."

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:2
segments: Thus says the LORD: "The people who survived the sword Found grace in the wilderness-Israel, when I went to give him rest."

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:3
segments: The LORD has appeared of old to me, [saying]: "Yes, I have loved you with an everlasting love; Therefore with lovingkindness I have drawn you.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:4
segments: Again I will build you, and you shall be rebuilt, O virgin of Israel! You shall again be adorned with your tambourines, And shall go forth in the dances of those who rejoice.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:5
segments: You shall yet plant vines on the mountains of Samaria; The planters shall plant and eat [them] as ordinary food.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:6
segments: For there shall be a day [When] the watchmen will cry on Mount Ephraim, 'Arise, and let us go up [to] Zion, To the LORD our God.'"

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:7
segments: For thus says the LORD: "Sing with gladness for Jacob, And shout among the chief of the nations; Proclaim, give praise, and say, 'O LORD, save Your people, The remnant of Israel!'

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:8
segments: Behold, I will bring them from the north country, And gather them from the ends of the earth, [Among] them the blind and the lame, The woman with child And the one who labors with child, together; A great throng shall return there.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:9
segments: They shall come with weeping, And with supplications I will lead them. I will cause them to walk by the rivers of waters, In a straight way in which they shall not stumble; For I am a Father to Israel, And Ephraim [is] My firstborn.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:10
segments: ¶"Hear the word of the LORD, O nations, And declare [it] in the isles afar off, and say, 'He who scattered Israel will gather him, And keep him as a shepherd [does] his flock.'

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:11
segments: For the LORD has redeemed Jacob, And ransomed him from the hand of one stronger than he.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:12
segments: Therefore they shall come and sing in the height of Zion, Streaming to the goodness of the LORD-For wheat and new wine and oil, For the young of the flock and the herd; Their souls shall be like a well-watered garden, And they shall sorrow no more at all.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:13
segments: "Then shall the virgin rejoice in the dance, And the young men and the old, together; For I will turn their mourning to joy, Will comfort them, And make them rejoice rather than sorrow.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:14
segments: I will satiate the soul of the priests with abundance, And My people shall be satisfied with My goodness, says the LORD."

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:15
segments: Thus says the LORD: "A voice was heard in Ramah, Lamentation [and] bitter weeping, Rachel weeping for her children, Refusing to be comforted for her children, Because they [are] no more."

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:16
segments: Thus says the LORD: "Refrain your voice from weeping, And your eyes from tears; For your work shall be rewarded, says the LORD, And they shall come back from the land of the enemy.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:17
segments: There is hope in your future, says the LORD, That [your] children shall come back to their own border.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:18
segments: ¶"I have surely heard Ephraim bemoaning himself: 'You have chastised me, and I was chastised, Like an untrained bull; Restore me, and I will return, For You [are] the LORD my God.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:19
segments: Surely, after my turning, I repented; And after I was instructed, I struck myself on the thigh; I was ashamed, yes, even humiliated, Because I bore the reproach of my youth.'

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:20
segments: [Is] Ephraim My dear son? [Is he] a pleasant child? For though I spoke against him, I earnestly remember him still; Therefore My heart yearns for him; I will surely have mercy on him, says the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:21
segments: "Set up signposts, Make landmarks; Set your heart toward the highway, The way in [which] you went. Turn back, O virgin of Israel, Turn back to these your cities.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:22
segments: How long will you gad about, O you backsliding daughter? For the LORD has created a new thing in the earth-A woman shall encompass a man."

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:23
segments: Thus says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: "They shall again use this speech in the land of Judah and in its cities, when I bring back their captivity: 'The LORD bless you, O home of justice, [and] mountain of holiness!'

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:24
segments: "And there shall dwell in Judah itself, and in all its cities together, farmers and those going out with flocks.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:25
segments: "For I have satiated the weary soul, and I have replenished every sorrowful soul."

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:26
segments: After this I awoke and looked around, and my sleep was sweet to me.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:27
segments: ¶"Behold, the days are coming, says the LORD, that I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of man and the seed of beast.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:28
segments: "And it shall come to pass, [that] as I have watched over them to pluck up, to break down, to throw down, to destroy, and to afflict, so I will watch over them to build and to plant, says the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:29
segments: "In those days they shall say no more: 'The fathers have eaten sour grapes, And the children's teeth are set on edge.'

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:30
segments: "But every one shall die for his own iniquity; every man who eats the sour grapes, his teeth shall be set on edge.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:31
segments: "Behold, the days are coming, says the LORD, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah-

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:32
segments: "not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day [that] I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt, My covenant which they broke, though I was a husband to them, says the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:33
segments: "But this [is] the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, says the LORD: I will put My law in their minds, and write it on their hearts; and I will be their God, and they shall be My people.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:34
segments: "No more shall every man teach his neighbor, and every man his brother, saying, 'Know the LORD,' for they all shall know Me, from the least of them to the greatest of them, says the LORD. For I will forgive their iniquity, and their sin I will remember no more."

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:35
segments: ¶Thus says the LORD, Who gives the sun for a light by day, The ordinances of the moon and the stars for a light by night, Who disturbs the sea, And its waves roar (The LORD of hosts [is] His name):

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:36
segments: "If those ordinances depart From before Me, says the LORD, [Then] the seed of Israel shall also cease From being a nation before Me forever."

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:37
segments: Thus says the LORD: "If heaven above can be measured, And the foundations of the earth searched out beneath, I will also cast off all the seed of Israel For all that they have done, says the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:38
segments: "Behold, the days are coming, says the LORD, that the city shall be built for the LORD from the Tower of Hananel to the Corner Gate.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:39
segments: "The surveyor's line shall again extend straight forward over the hill Gareb; then it shall turn toward Goath.

entries.title: Jeremiah 31:40
segments: "And the whole valley of the dead bodies and of the ashes, and all the fields as far as the Brook Kidron, to the corner of the Horse Gate toward the east, [shall be] holy to the LORD. It shall not be plucked up or thrown down anymore forever."
